ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in $\triangle ABC$, $AD$ is the altitude, $AE$ and $BF$ are the angle bisectors, and they intersect at point $O$. Given $\angle ABC=50^\circ$ and $\angle C=70^\circ$, find the measures of $\angle DAE$ and $\angle BOA$.
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $AD \perp BC$,\\
it follows that $\angle ADC = 90^\circ$,\\
Since $\angle C = 70^\circ$,\\
it follows that $\angle CAD = 180^\circ - 90^\circ - 70^\circ = 20^\circ$,\\
Since $\angle ABC = 50^\circ$, \\
it follows that $\angle BAC = 180^\circ - \angle ABC - \angle C = 60^\circ$,\\
Since AE is the bisector of $\angle BAC$,\\
it follows that $\angle EAC = \angle BAE = 30^\circ$,\\
therefore $\angle EAD = \angle EAC - \angle CAD = 30^\circ - 20^\circ = \boxed{10^\circ}$,\\
Since BF is the bisector of $\angle ABC$,\\
it follows that $\angle ABO = 25^\circ$,\\
therefore $\angle BOA = 180^\circ - \angle BAO - \angle ABO = 180^\circ - 30^\circ - 25^\circ = \boxed{125^\circ}$,\\
Hence, the measures of $\angle DAE$ and $\angle BOA$ are $10^\circ$ and $125^\circ$, respectively.
